subject: mathematics
question_text: Prove that tanh(x − y) = (tanh x − tanh y)/(1 − tanh x tanh y).

mark_split.label: Divide by cosh x cosh y

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Use the difference formulas
steps.margin_note: First mark. tanh is sinh over cosh, so write both parts using the difference formulas. These come from the addition formulas with y replaced by −y.
steps.memory_tip: Replace y by −y in the addition formulas: sinh(−y) = −sinh y and cosh(−y) = cosh y, so both signs flip to minus.
lines: L.H.S = tanh(x − y) = sinh(x − y)/cosh(x − y)
Numerator = sinh x cosh y − cosh x sinh y
Denominator = cosh x cosh y − sinh x sinh y

recall.must_convey: That tanh(x − y) is written as sinh(x − y) over cosh(x − y) and both are expanded by the difference formulas.
accept: tanh is sinh over cosh so write both with the difference formulas
numerator is sinh x cosh y minus cosh x sinh y
denominator is cosh x cosh y minus sinh x sinh y
sinh by cosh ga rasi difference formulas apply cheyyali
these come from the addition formulas with y replaced by minus y

steps.why: There is no separate definition of tanh(x − y) to expand. The only route is through sinh and cosh, whose difference formulas the chapter already has.
common_mistakes: Writing a plus in the denominator, copying the tan formula from trigonometry.
Expanding tanh(x − y) as tanh x − tanh y.

steps.label: Divide by cosh x cosh y
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Divide the top and the bottom by cosh x cosh y. This is allowed because cosh is never less than 1, so the product is never zero.
steps.memory_tip: Divide top and bottom by cosh x cosh y: every sinh over its own cosh becomes a tanh.
lines: cosh x ≥ 1 and cosh y ≥ 1, so cosh x cosh y ≠ 0
Divide the top and the bottom by cosh x cosh y
The top becomes tanh x − tanh y
The bottom becomes 1 − tanh x tanh y

lines.text: = (tanh x − tanh y)/(1 − tanh x tanh y)

recall.must_convey: That dividing the numerator and the denominator by cosh x cosh y turns each sinh into a tanh and gives the required form.
accept: divide the top and the bottom by cosh x cosh y
each sinh over its own cosh becomes a tanh
the top gives tanh x minus tanh y and the bottom gives one minus tanh x tanh y
cosh x cosh y tho divide cheste tanh vasthundi

heard_as: divide by cosh x cosh y

steps.why: Dividing by cosh x cosh y is the one move that converts every term at once, because each sinh is paired with the cosh of the same variable.
common_mistakes: Dividing by cosh(x − y) instead of by cosh x cosh y.
Getting 1 in the numerator and forgetting it belongs in the denominator.
